visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with her hair tied in two pigtails and wearing a denim overall dress over a floral t-shirt stands in a light-filled living room. She holds a small grey plush elephant by its trunk and stares intently at a step where a black robot vacuum is operating. The room features light wood floors and shelves filled with children's books and toys. (2) The girl squats down slightly while continuing to watch the robot, then stands up and turns toward the camera. Her facial expression is a mix of curiosity and slight apprehension. She reaches up to touch her cheek and then covers both eyes with her hands as if hiding. (3) The camera captures a close-up of the girl's face as she looks back toward the step, her eyes wide. She then looks down at the ground, appearing to observe the robot's movement. (4) The robot vacuum is shown moving across the upper landing of the room near a white cabinet. The girl turns back to watch it again from a distance, then looks down at her elephant toy. (5) A final pink graphic screen appears with a cartoon illustration of a girl holding a peach and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
